title: 第0015章 钱富进入仙坊的机会第0016章 青云仙坊上千灵石
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
被识破，一道身影从暗处走了出来，看着戒备的陆青禾，钱富急忙解释：“这位道兄，我没有恶意，不用如此警惕。
在宗门内，是不允许大打出手的，被执法队知道了，就会受到严厉的惩罚。”
陆青禾却不敢掉以轻心轻信他人的话，这人同样身上散发出炼气三层的实力。
陆青禾并没有动手，开口问道：“既然如此，道兄跟着我意欲何为。”
钱富摆手道：“道兄不要误会，我并不是跟踪道兄，而是有一桩天大的机缘要送给道兄。”
大机缘，陆青禾更是不信，在宗门内哪有这样的好事轮到他，真的有机缘，哪个不是藏着捂着。
这两年时间他对修仙界有了深入的认知，在宗门之中也是一个不小心就万劫不复，更何况是更加庞大的修仙界。
陆青禾拒绝道：“我福运浅薄，难以承受道兄的机缘，如若没事，我先走了。”
看陆青禾要离开，钱富急了，急忙喊道：“道兄且慢，如果我能够让道兄卖掉你的灵米和血参，还能够买到聚灵丹，道兄也不想听听？”
钱富的话让转身陆青禾停住了脚步，陆青禾疑惑的问道：“你要买我的灵米和血参？”
钱富摇头：“买不起，不说是我，在整个杂役弟子之中没人能够拿出这么多灵石，更不可能有人能够拿出聚灵丹。”
“我相信道兄也明白这个道理。”
这点陆青禾认同，杂役弟子想要获得灵石和丹药太困难了。
他如果不是有黑土空间，现在连一块灵石都很难获得。
拿出十几块灵石除了少数炼气三层的弟子，其他人是不可能的。
钱富心有唏嘘：“杂役弟子只是名义上的宗门弟子，不像那些外门弟子每个月都有灵石和丹药的福利可以领取。”
“杂役弟子说直白点只是宗门的奴仆，我等只有达到炼气四层才能进入外门，才会被当成真正的弟子，获得更好的修炼资源。”
“我想道兄也是为了冲击练气四层，才会卖掉灵米和血参，购买聚灵丹。”
陆青禾没有否认，点头承认：“没错。”

“不知道道兄有什么办法让我卖掉灵米和血参？”
对于钱富冠冕堂皇的感慨陆青禾不感兴趣，他感兴趣的是如何能够出手手中的资源。
钱富说出两个字：“仙坊！”
陆青禾一听，满脸的不爽：“道兄这是拿我开玩笑，我等杂役弟子不说到仙坊做交易，就是离开仙门也是不可能的事情。”
仙坊陆青禾也知道，是距离太玄宗百里之外的一座各种修士聚集的交易坊市，他也听其他杂役弟子说过。
但是这对陆青禾来说完全不可能的事情，他要是能够离开太玄宗到仙坊，怎么可能到杂役交易区摆摊。
钱富笑了笑：“正常情况是不可能，但是在下族兄是一外门弟子，平时负责宗门的采办，他平时带几个杂役弟子负责帮忙完全不成问题。”
“我看道兄就十分适合这样的任务。”
这让陆青禾眼睛一亮，要是真的能够去到仙坊，将黑土空间的灵米和血参卖掉，能够获得的灵石他自己都无法想象。
只是他不敢确定眼前的人说的是真是假。
“我要如何相信你？”
钱富并没有因为陆青禾不相信而生气，这在修仙界再正常不过的事情。

After being seen through, a figure came out of the darkness. Looking at the alert Lu Qinghe, Qian Fu hurriedly explained: "Brother Taoist, I don't have any ill intentions, so there is no need to be so vigilant.
Within the sect, fighting is not allowed. If the law enforcement team finds out, they will be severely punished. "
Lu Qinghe did not dare to take other people's words lightly. This person also exuded the strength of the third level of Qi Refining.
Lu Qinghe did not take action, but asked: "In that case, what do you want, Brother Taoist, to follow me?"
Qian Fu waved his hand and said, "Brother Tao, don't get me wrong. I'm not following Brother Tao, but I have a great opportunity to give to Brother Tao."
Lu Qinghe didn't believe in the great opportunity. How could such a good thing happen to him in the sect? If there was a real opportunity, no one would hide it.
In the past two years, he has gained an in-depth understanding of the world of immortality. Among the sects, he is the only one who can be doomed if he is not careful, let alone the even larger world of immortality.
Lu Qinghe refused: "My luck is shallow and I can't bear the opportunity of Brother Dao. If nothing happens, I'll leave first."
Seeing that Lu Qinghe was about to leave, Qian Fu became anxious and shouted hurriedly: "Brother Taoist, wait a minute. If I can make Brother Taoist sell your spiritual rice and blood ginseng, and also buy the Spirit-Gathering Pill, Brother Taoist doesn't want to hear it either?"
Qian Fu's words caused Lu Qinghe to stop when he turned around. Lu Qinghe asked doubtfully: "You want to buy my spiritual rice and blood ginseng?"
Qian Fu shook his head: "I can't afford it. Not to mention me, no one among the servant disciples can come up with so many spirit stones, and it's even less likely that anyone can come up with the Spirit Gathering Pill."
"I believe Brother Tao also understands this truth."
Lu Qinghe agrees with this. It is too difficult for the handyman disciples to obtain spiritual stones and elixirs.
If he didn't have the black earth space, it would be difficult to obtain even a spiritual stone now.
It is impossible for anyone except a few disciples at the third level of Qi Refining to take out more than a dozen spirit stones.
Qian Fu sighed: "The handyman disciples are only nominal disciples of the sect. Unlike the outer disciples, who can receive benefits of spiritual stones and elixirs every month."
"To put it bluntly, the handyman disciples are just slaves of the sect. Only when we reach the fourth level of Qi Refining can we enter the outer sect. Only then will we be regarded as true disciples and receive better cultivation resources."
"I think Brother Dao also sold his spiritual rice and blood ginseng to buy spiritual gathering pills in order to reach the fourth level of Qi training."
Lu Qinghe did not deny it, but nodded and admitted: "That's right."
"I wonder if Brother Dao can help me sell my spiritual rice and blood ginseng?"
Lu Qinghe was not interested in the high-sounding sentiments about money and wealth. What he was interested in was how to get rid of the resources in his hands.
Qian Fu said two words: "Xianfang!"
When Lu Qinghe heard this, his face was full of displeasure: "Brother Taoist, you are making fun of me. It is impossible for us and other handyman disciples to leave the Immortal Sect unless they come to the Immortal Fang to do business."
Xianfang Lu Qinghe also knew that it was a trading market a hundred miles away from Taixuan Sect where various monks gathered. He also heard from other servant disciples.
But this is completely impossible for Lu Qinghe. If he can leave Taixuanzong and go to Xianfang, how can he set up a stall in the handyman trading area.
Qian Fu smiled: "Under normal circumstances, this is impossible, but my brother is an outer disciple and is usually responsible for the sect's procurement. It is not a problem for him to bring a few handyman disciples to help him."
"I think Brother Dao is very suitable for such a task."
This made Lu Qinghe's eyes light up. If he could really go to Xianfang and sell the spiritual rice and blood ginseng in the black earth space, he would be able to get more spiritual stones than he could imagine.
But he wasn't sure whether what the person in front of him said was true or false.
"How can I trust you?"
Qian Fu was not angry because Lu Qinghe didn't believe it. This was a normal thing in the world of immortality.
